none: PAS LANCUM-54B436: Roman imported Samian Ware/Terre Sigillata pottery ware base fragment no makers mark 70 – 240AD.
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman imported Samian Ware/Terre Sigillata pottery ware base fragment no makers mark 70 - 240AD. The fabric is circular in plan very hard is light orange in colour and has an orange/red 'satin' gloss slip on both the inner and outer surface. There is no stamp and the fragment is peculiar in that it does not appear to be a base being slightly curved with no inset for a stand. It is possibly a lid…
